deleteInfo.title: Delete your account
deleteInfo.intro: You can delete your account yourself at any time, from the app or the website.
deleteInfo.inApp: In the app: open More → Account → Delete account.
deleteInfo.onWeb: On the website: log in, open Account → Delete account.
deleteInfo.otp: We send an OTP to your mobile number to confirm it's you.
deleteInfo.deleted: Name, mobile number, email, photo and profile details are deleted right away.
deleteInfo.sessions: You are logged out on every device.
deleteInfo.downloads: Downloaded videos are removed from your phone and their offline licences are cancelled.
deleteInfo.kept: Exam scores and attendance stay with your teacher as "Deleted user", with no personal details.
deleteInfo.when: Deletion happens immediately and can't be undone.
deleteInfo.help: Can't log in? Contact {{contact}} from your registered mobile number and we'll delete the account for you.
deleteInfo.helpNoContact: Can't log in? Contact your teacher or the school office from your registered mobile number.
